offers.description: Available as an individual service pick (($300 / $225 / $150 / $150 / $75 / Custom USD) for individuals / ($300 / $225 / $150 / $150 / $75 / Custom USD) for businesses, each for 5 days of live training + 5 days of dedicated support, 10 days total coverage), or as part of our comprehensive programs: Business Training ($3,000 USD for 60 days: 30d training + 30d guidance/materials, 30 working days over 8 weeks with 8 - 10 days as holidays and recovery days, 4 hours per day, up to 10 participants, +$300/extra seat) or Personal Training ($3,000 USD for 60 days: 30d training + 30d guidance/materials, 30 working days over 6 weeks with 8 - 10 days as holidays and recovery days, 4 hours per day, 1 person only). Clients are free to pick and choose their services. Full 195-country Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) supported across all service pricing.

serviceOutput: Markdown Knowledge Vault: Obsidian vault with templates, frontmatter and Git backup.
Automated Capture: PDF, web and email notes converted to clean Markdown.
Local Model Tagging: Ollama-based summaries and tags with human review.
Cited Question Answering: Embeddings and a Chroma index that answer from your own notes.
Weekly Review Digest: Scheduled summary of new and unfinished notes.
